item.title: Version 1.4.13
item.description:
• Fix iOS mirroring getting stuck on Connecting by timing out hung device-discovery tools and cleaning up stuck child processes
  • Add regression coverage for command execution timeouts so future device scans cannot block indefinitely

item.title: Version 1.4.12
item.description:
• Disable the crash-prone native Fast iOS mirror path in live builds and clear any old saved Fast preference so iPhone mirroring opens in Stable mode
  • Keep the Fast iOS mirror controls visible as disabled in normal builds, with Stable mode still available
  • Exclude transient Dock overlays such as the command-tab switcher from screenshots

item.title: Version 1.4.11
item.description: • Fixed screenshots sometimes showing content from behind the window being captured: after a monitor was plugged in or removed, a stale internal exclusion could hide the frontmost window from area and full-screen captures

item.title: Version 1.4.10
item.description:
• Screenshots and text capture now stay available while a screen recording is running — the menu bar no longer hides them during a recording
  • Screenshots taken during an area recording come out clean: the recording border and dimming hide for the instant of capture

item.title: Version 1.4.9
item.description:
• Keep Android mirroring inside Captr with ADB-only capture
  • Remove the external scrcpy mirror dependency from setup
  • Rename the mirror Screenshot button to Copy

item.title: Version 1.4.8
item.description:
• Fix fast iOS recording crash when capture timestamps are invalid
  • Fall back to monotonic host timing for native iPhone recording frames

item.title: Version 1.4.7
item.description:
• Reuse the existing device mirror window when the iOS button is pressed while mirroring or recording is already active.
  • Avoid tearing down and rebuilding the active mirror window, which could crash during an active iPhone stream recording.

item.title: Version 1.4.6
item.description:
• Add a visible Stable/Fast iOS mirror selector to the capture toolbar.
  • Replace the hidden-feeling Fast iOS checkbox with clear Stable/Fast controls in settings and the menu bar.

item.title: Version 1.4.5
item.description:
• Add a Fast iOS Mirror toggle in settings and the menu bar.
  • Persist the iOS mirror mode and use Stable mode by default unless Fast is selected.
  • Add regression coverage for the persisted iOS mirror mode.

item.title: Version 1.4.4
item.description: • Default iPhone mirroring to the safer screenshot stream to avoid macOS iOSScreenCapture crashes after wake.\n- Keep the native low-latency iPhone mirror path behind an explicit developer opt-in flag.\n- Add regression coverage for the iPhone mirror transport policy.

item.title: Version 1.4.3
item.description: • Capture shortcuts no longer bring the Captr window to the front or steal focus from the app you're working in — the selection overlay now behaves like the system screenshot tool

item.title: Version 1.4.2
item.description: • Fixed the Dock randomly appearing in screenshots: with Dock auto-hide enabled, ending an area selection near the screen edge slid the Dock in just as the capture fired. Area and full-screen captures now leave the auto-hidden Dock out.

item.title: Version 1.4.1
item.description:
• Fixed Android mirroring: the scrcpy player couldn't locate adb when launched from the app, so the mirror window never appeared
  • If the Android player fails to start, Captr now opens its built-in mirror window and shows the reason instead of failing silently
  • The iOS button shows a connecting spinner while the iPhone mirror starts up

item.title: Version 1.4.0
item.description:
• Smooth iPhone mirroring: live video now comes from macOS's built-in screen-capture engine (the same one QuickTime uses) at the device's full frame rate, replacing the slow screenshot stream
  • Record directly from the iPhone mirror window — recordings follow the phone's exact frame timing, so scrolling and animations stay smooth
  • Higher-quality iPhone recordings (12 Mbps at up to 60 fps)
  • Mirror windows update the moment a frame arrives instead of polling on a timer
  • Fixed a crash when the iPhone screen feed failed to start

item.title: Version 1.3.15
item.description:
• iOS device connection no longer freezes the app while it sets up, and you're asked before any admin-privileges prompt
  • Screenshots and recordings now capture at the correct resolution on every display, including non-retina and mixed-DPI setups
  • Android recording fixes: portrait devices are no longer distorted, long recordings finalize correctly at the device's 3-minute limit, and special characters in forwarded text now work
  • More reliable detection of helper tools (idevice/adb/scrcpy/ffplay) across both Apple Silicon and Intel Homebrew locations
  • Recordings save to your Downloads folder, with separate menu-bar items to open the Recordings and Screenshots folders
  • Deleting a recording or screenshot now moves it to the Trash instead of removing it permanently
  • The media library updates instantly after each capture instead of rescanning and regenerating every thumbnail
  • Microphone capture failures now show a notification instead of failing silently

item.title: Version 1.3.14
item.description: • Route iPhone mirroring away from the native CoreMediaIO preview path to avoid crashes on macOS 26.\n- Try the low-latency H.264 iPhone stream before falling back to compatibility mode.\n- Preserve iPhone screenshot color profiles in compatibility mode by streaming downscaled PNG frames.\n- Disable extended dynamic range on iPhone mirror preview layers to reduce harsh contrast.

item.title: Version 1.3.13
item.description:
• Add wired iPhone mirroring controls with native AVFoundation startup, low-latency playback, and compatibility fallback when macOS delivers a black stream.
  • Add Android mirroring controls backed by scrcpy for lower-latency device streaming.
  • Add camera entitlement and permission handling for iPhone mirroring.
  • Harden iOS device detection, UDID normalization, mirror window focus, and native-session teardown around disconnects and sleep/wake.

item.title: Version 1.3.12
item.description:
• Fix screen capture after connecting an external monitor by refreshing ScreenCaptureKit display/window state before capture.
  • Capture full-screen from the display under the pointer when multiple monitors are connected.
  • Normalize selection overlays to local screen bounds so area and window capture target external displays correctly.

item.title: Version 1.3.11
item.description:
• Fix area screenshots on external monitors by clamping selected regions to the captured display before cropping.
  • Share screen-coordinate conversion across screenshot, recording, window selection, and translation overlay paths.

item.title: Version 1.3.10
item.description:
• Restore the Captr logo in the menu bar instead of the generic plus icon.
  • Request and verify screen capture permission before all screenshot modes.
  • Add system audio usage text and the audio input entitlement for recording permissions.

item.title: Version 1.3.9
item.description:
• Restore bundled app resources so release builds include the app icon and asset catalog.
  • Avoid blocking releases on DMG notarization after the app is already notarized and stapled.

item.title: Version 1.3.7
item.description: • Fix window screenshots and recordings with hover-to-select window targeting.\n- Fix annotation saving so drawn markup is included in exported screenshots.\n- Improve area capture, window capture, and device mirroring reliability.\n- Avoid unsupported iOS recording flows and unexpected microphone permission prompts.

item.title: Version 1.3.6
item.description: • Fix area screenshots showing the desktop wallpaper instead of Captr's own windows. v1.3.4's filter excluded every Captr window from area captures; the overlay-hiding the filter was guarding against is already handled by alphaValue=0 + orderOut + CATransaction.flush + a 150 ms sleep before capture.

item.title: Version 1.3.5
item.description: Fix screen recording producing zero-byte files on macOS 26: the previous fix tried to strip ScreenCaptureKit's stereoscopic-disparity attachment off each frame, but the tag lives on the upstream IOSurface and can't be removed via CVBuffer or IOSurface APIs. AVAssetWriter then rejected every frame with err -16122 ("operation could not be completed"). Maintain a pixel-buffer pool, deep-copy each frame into a clean buffer, and append the copy instead. Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context)

item.title: Version 1.3.4
item.description: - Fix screen recording failing with "operation could not be completed" on macOS 26: ScreenCaptureKit attaches a stereoscopic-disparity tag to every frame that AVAssetWriter rejects when encoding plain H.264 — strip it before append. Pin source/output color to Rec.709/sRGB so they agree on extended-gamut displays. - Fix area recording on a non-primary monitor: pick the display containing the selected area, and translate the area to display-local coords before assigning to sourceRect. - Keep the area-selection overlay out of area screenshots: prime the SCRunningApplication for our own bundle and exclude it from the capture filter; force the overlay window to vanish before the capture pipeline reads back. Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context)

item.title: Version 1.3.3
item.description: - "Check for Updates…" menu item now shows a spinner and "Checking for updates…" while Sparkle is contacting the server, so it's clear something is happening when the appcast fetch is slow. Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context)

item.title: Version 1.3.2
item.description: - Area screenshot to clipboard and OCR/translation paths now use ScreenCaptureKit's SCScreenshotManager instead of the deprecated CGWindowListCreateImage. macOS 15 was nagging users to re-grant Screen Recording permission once a month for any app still on the legacy API; the modern API doesn't trigger the prompt. - Recording errors are no longer silent: when a recording produces an empty file (e.g. permission missing, no frames received, asset writer error) the menu bar now surfaces the actual reason instead of the overlay just disappearing. - Removed Utilities/CGWindowCapture.h/.m and the now-empty bridging header reference. Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context)

item.title: Version 1.3.1
item.description: - Re-cut v1.3.0 to push the appcast forward — auto-update users were stuck on v1.2.6 because the previous release didn't refresh appcast.xml - In-place translation overlay replaces the popup: translated text is composited onto the captured screenshot at the exact screen coordinates you dragged - Movable overlay with Save, Copy, and Close toolbar buttons; Cmd+S saves to the screenshots library, Cmd+C copies the composite, Esc dismisses - Claude API translation engine as an alternative to Apple's on-device translator (segments batched into one Messages API call for speed) - Settings → Translation panel for picking the engine and storing an Anthropic API key in the Keychain Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context)

item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description: - In-place translation overlay replaces the popup: translated text is composited onto the captured screenshot and shown at the exact screen coordinates you dragged, with original text masked behind a sampled background color - Movable overlay with Save, Copy, and Close toolbar buttons; Cmd+S saves to the screenshots library, Cmd+C copies the composite, Esc dismisses - Claude API translation engine as an alternative to Apple's on-device translator (segments batched into one Messages API call for speed) - Settings → Translation panel for picking the engine and storing an Anthropic API key in the Keychain Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context)
